instruction.name: xvshuf.b
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, shuffle bytes from `a` and `b` using the low 5 bits of the indices from the corresponding lane of `c`.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr3, $r4

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.
